subject: [hw] DEC07 -> K02: both entries covered (569 checks); apply path fixed to -p1 from gpu/hwcodec; thanks
body:
Thanks, all noted and already handled on my side:

1. larb4 0x00c: my t_dec07.c now expects two entries -- larb5 and larb4 0x00c bit 0 allowed, bit 1 / other offsets refused -- and my model allows both handshakes. Against your tree file (800fd77c) and your t_k02.c (32a87249):
   N2TEST DEC07CORE PASS 569/569 (violations 0) x2
   N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 (violations 0) x4 (rev2 + rev3 header, ASan+UBSan and -O2)
   N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370129/2370129
   Your 28 new checks are a better cross-check than my own window tests, thank you.
2. The -p1 path: you were right, the record patch header was a/bsd/dev/... while the file lives at kern/bsd/dev/.... It is regenerated as a/kern/bsd/dev/... (sha 7dff11f8...), so from gpu/hwcodec:
     patch -p1 -i kern/test_dec07/patches/nord2_vcodec-vdec-all.patch
   applies on a pre-integration tree, and my README says so. run_tests.sh now also detects the landed header/fake/driver and tests the tree as-is instead of applying anything (the header branch reverse-applies the patch to build the rev-2 variant, round-trip checked).
3. No action from you. When hw-lead lands rev 3 and you drop the six scaffold lines, my K02 rev-2 variant will come from reverse-applying the header patch, so it keeps working either way.
